_readme: 📸 인물 기본 사진(룩) — 유료 실시간 사진·영상을 만들 때 기준으로 쓰는 '옷차림 + 장소' 모음. 파일은 public/avatar/personas/<id>/base/<id>.jpg (scripts/make-looks.mjs 로 생성). keywords 에 걸리면 그 룩을 먼저 쓰고, 없으면 시간대(when)로 고른다.

looks.label: 잠옷·집
looks.outfit: wearing comfortable loose pajamas or soft loungewear, hair relaxed and slightly undone
looks.place: at home at night, in a cozy bedroom or living room with warm soft lamp light

looks.label: 평상복·집
looks.outfit: wearing a relaxed everyday outfit at home, a soft tee or loose knit with comfortable pants
looks.place: at home in the living room or kitchen, natural indoor light

looks.label: 평상복·마트
looks.outfit: wearing a simple everyday casual outfit with a light cardigan or jacket, small bag
looks.place: inside a neighborhood grocery store or market aisle, bright even lighting

looks.label: 외출복·집(나가기 전)
looks.outfit: wearing a put-together going-out outfit with a coat or jacket, bag in hand, ready to leave
looks.place: at the entryway of their home, about to head out, daylight from the doorway

looks.label: 외출복·야외
looks.outfit: wearing a stylish season-appropriate going-out outfit
looks.place: outdoors on a city street, park path or near a cafe, natural daylight

looks.label: 정장·행사장
looks.outfit: wearing elegant formal attire, a well-fitted suit or an understated formal dress
looks.place: at an indoor event venue or hotel lobby, warm evening lighting
